items.title: Solo or Pair Programming for K-12 Students? Learning Outcomes and In-game Behaviors in a Game-Based Learning Environment
items.why_it_matters: A 2026 TechTrends learning-analytics study of solo versus pair programming in a six-week K-12 game-based learning environment; directly relevant to in-game behavior, computational thinking, and collaborative learning.
items.missing_full_text_reason: Publisher page exposes an abstract/preview but indicates subscription content; no lawful author or institutional repository manuscript was verified. A third-party copy was not imported because its copyright status was unclear.
items.lawful_acquisition_route: Request the author manuscript, check ERIC/institutional repositories, or use library interlibrary loan.
